name: twtdash
description: twtdash — sync, auto-categorize and beautifully browse your X (Twitter) bookmarks.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/extension install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.ext:zip: npm --prefix apps/extension run zip && npm --prefix apps/extension run zip:firefox
scripts.release: npm run ext:test && npm run ext:zip && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('apps/web/public/downloads',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('apps/extension/.output/twtdash-extension-1.0.0-chrome.zip','apps/web/public/downloads/twtdash-chrome.zip');fs.copyFileSync('apps/extension/.output/twtdash-extension-1.0.0-firefox.zip','apps/web/public/downloads/twtdash-firefox.zip')" && npm run web:build
